title: land
description: Land at a position, given as landing_position or as a point geo feature by geofeature_id, never both. A geo feature is a live reference: the Asset lands at the place as it stands when it gets there, and if the place is changed or deleted first, the Asset decides how to carry on. Without either, the Asset lands where it is when the Task starts. The Asset climbs or descends to the transit altitude, or keeps its current altitude if none is given. It flies over the position and lands.
